entries.scientificReview: Native2n=4 symbolic set model has two long/two short unduplicated chromosomes, the same four duplicated chromosomes, then one long/one short duplicated in one meiotic-I product. Human count row46/46,46/92,23/46 matches chromosomes/DNA molecules per cell; picture and human counts are explicitly distinct.

One→two→four cell inventory and46 duplicated→23 duplicated→23 unduplicated per-cell counts verified. v2 moves tree right to separate labels from circles. Differentiation does not halve counts; no replication between divisions.

Prophase-I prenatal and metaphase-II ovulatory pauses,46 duplicated→23 duplicated→23 unduplicated maternal counts, and unequal polar-body branches verified. v2 routes both branches clear of text. Final count excludes sperm; no three-polar-body inevitability or completed meiosis at ovulation.

Separate ovarian/uterine tracks align on one explicit illustrative1–28day axis. Day1 starts bleeding; follicular phase includes early shedding on the separate uterine track. Event overlap and individual variability explicit; not universal day14 ovulation.

Both forward and return arrows inspected with explicit negative/positive signs. Sustained high estrogen and suitable context qualify positive feedback. Sparse peak values do not prove a universal threshold or exact ovulation time.

Ovarian corpus luteum→steroid support→uterine maintenance chain distinct from conditional withdrawal. hCG maintains early ovarian support, progesterone supports lining; menstrual tissue is not the oocyte.

Sample dots2/2,4/8,6/4 share a0–10relative axis. Two paths pass all three and peak before versus after day4, demonstrating unmeasured uncertainty. Illustration distinct from required six-day keyed graph and from actual measured concentration.

Qualitative follicular decline, changed ovarian support, end of recurring cycles and possible higher pituitary FSH retain feedback direction. No fixed age, individual diagnosis or assertion that all hormones fall.
